bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks, bags and purses up to 8.5" x 11" are allowed at BleauLive Theater. All bags are searched at entry.
allowed: Backpacks, bags and purses up to 8.5" x 11"
prohibited: Backpacks, bags and purses larger than 8.5" x 11"
Video cameras, professional cameras and tripods
Throwable items such as glow sticks, bottles and balls
bagPolicy.note: This is the policy for BleauLive Theater, the resort's concert venue. All guests go through metal detectors. Some events require phones to be locked in pouches. No bag check is mentioned.

parking.note: Fontainebleau Las Vegas offers complimentary self-parking for Nevada residents and Fontainebleau Rewards members until May 31, 2026. Hotel guests enjoy complimentary self-parking for the duration of their stay. Self-parking costs $20 for up to 24 hours after complimentary eligibility ends, with special event pricing applicable during certain times.

rideshare.note: Follow signs for North Valet & Rideshare or South Valet & Rideshare. Both locations are marked on the Level 1 resort map.

concessions.note: Fontainebleau Las Vegas offers 24-hour in-room dining with a variety of global-inspired menu options. Guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch, dinner, and late-night dining, with specific hours for each meal period. Orders can be placed via phone or online.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Scooters and wheelchairs are available at the bell stand based on availability, and fees may apply. Service animals are permitted in the resort, though pets are not.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Fontainebleau Las Vegas's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Fontainebleau Las Vegas. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: BleauLive Theater is located on Level 2 of Fontainebleau Las Vegas, next to Papi Steak. Door times are set per show, so check your event page.
